description: Out-of-sample check of the frozen English research rank (research-rank-v1, weights momentum 0.25 / value 0.75 / low-vol 0) on Japanese cards, ranked only against Japanese cards. Written before the first run on October 7, 2026. Nothing is selected or tuned: the weights come from the English study. Changing any value is a new experiment: bump the version and keep the old results.

gate.note: All checks must pass for the app to show Japanese research ranks (FUTURESIGHT_JA_RESEARCH=shadow). These mirror what the English rank showed before it was put in shadow mode: positive lift overall, after a one-month entry delay and on held-out sets.

checks.label: Top-quintile 12-month net return beats the all-card basket on average
Still beats it when buying one month later
Beats it on held-out sets (never used anywhere)
Positive mean lift on a majority of entry dates
At least 4 entry dates and 100 distinct cards across 5 sets
